= Bibliography list semantics

The first citation is <<ref-a>>, the labelled citation is <<ref-b>>, and the first citation repeats as <<ref-a>>.
An explicit citation label is <<ref-c,custom citation>>.
The numeric citation is <<ref-numbered>>.
The regular anchor is referenced as <<regular-anchor>>.

[bibliography]
== References

.Primary sources
[#reference-list.references-role]
* [[[ref-a]]] First reference.
* [[[ref-b,Short label]]] Second reference with a custom label.
* [[[ref-c,Third label]]] Third reference with a custom label.
* [[[ref-numbered,1]]] A numerically labelled reference.
* [\[[escaped]]] Escaped bibliography syntax remains literal.
* [[regular-anchor]] A regular inline anchor stays hidden.
* [[[ref-block]]] Reference with attached content.
+
An attached paragraph with *formatting*.
